basic_info.description: Nestled on one of the Excelsior's most charming, tree-lined blocks, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home (1,922 sq. ft. per tax records) blends 1912 character with sunlit living spaces. With inviting curb appeal, solar panels, EV charging, and a thoughtful layout, it offers both style and function in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods.  The main level features a bright sunroom entry, cozy living room, two bedrooms, and a full bath. At its heart, a spacious open kitchen and dining area are illuminated by skylights, creating an airy setting ideal for gatherings.  The lower level provides incredible flexibility with a media room, third bedroom, full bath, office nook, laundry, and direct access to the backyard and garage with abundant storage.  A generous backyard invites gardening, play, or entertaining, while a one-car garage with EV charging adds convenience. Two blocks from Crocker Amazon Playground and near McLaren Park, the home also offers easy access to Geneva and Mission's restaurants, coffee shops, and transit. 647 Athens delivers not just a home, but a lifestyle rooted in charm, community, and city living.
